lines: You agree to plans you don’t want, just to avoid conflict.
He cancels last minute, yet you’re still upset.
Your brain tricks you into thinking you’re the flexible one.
That is why you feel exhausted, even when you’re the one giving.
One honest “no” will free more than a thousand yeses.
Your time is not a bargaining chip.
Say it, set it, protect it.
Follow for more daily psychology that can change your life.
cta: Follow for more daily psychology that can change your life.
caption: Your “yes” should never feel like a surrender. Save this if you’ve said too much.
